units.source_text: Divan将要又一次给他的心赋予以新的力量。

en.t: The Divan was about to give his heart new strength once again.

units.source_text: 那是他不了解的“东方的歌德”。

en.t: It was the Eastern Goethe whom he did not understand.

units.source_text: 他看见悠闲的站在善恶彼岸的歌德，察觉到近似绝望的羡慕。

en.t: Seeing Goethe standing calmly beyond good and evil, he felt an envy close to despair.

units.source_text: 他认为诗人歌德比诗人基督更伟大。

en.t: He thought that Goethe the poet was greater than Christ the poet.

units.source_text: 在这位诗人的眼里，除了阿克罗波利斯和各各他之外，还绽放着阿拉伯玫瑰花朵。

en.t: In this poet's eyes, besides the Acropolis and Golgotha, Arabian roses were also in bloom.

units.source_text: 如果多少有一点力量能去追踪这位诗人的足迹……

en.t: If only he had even a little strength to follow in this poet's footsteps...

units.source_text: 他读完诗集，在无比激动的情绪平息之后，不由深深蔑视自己，

en.t: After he finished reading the collection of poems, once his overwhelming excitement had subsided, he could not help deeply despising himself,

units.source_text: 因为他在生活中和宦官没什么两样。

en.t: because in life he was no different from a eunuch.
